product.title: Full-Day Small Group Yosemite & Glacier Point Tour Including Hotel Pickup

description.text: Travel from Fresno to Yosemite on a full-day small-group tour with hotel pickup. Visit Yosemite Valley landmarks including Tunnel View, Yosemite Falls, and El Capitan before ascending to Glacier Point for one of the park's most dramatic panoramas.

highlights: Hotel pickup and drop-off from Fresno area
Yosemite Valley and Glacier Point in one day
Photo stops at Tunnel View and Yosemite Falls

start.description: Hotel pickup from select Fresno-area hotels between 6:00 AM and 6:30 AM.

end.description: Return to your Fresno hotel after the full-day tour.

product.itinerarySummary: Travel from Fresno to Yosemite on a full-day small-group tour with hotel pickup.

itineraryItems.title: Tunnel View
itineraryItems.description: First valley overlook stop with views of El Capitan, Half Dome, and Bridalveil Fall.

itineraryItems.title: Yosemite Valley
itineraryItems.description: Explore the valley floor with stops near Yosemite Falls and Swinging Bridge.

itineraryItems.title: El Capitan
itineraryItems.description: Photo stop at El Capitan Meadow beneath the 3,000-foot granite wall.

itineraryItems.title: Glacier Point
itineraryItems.description: Ascend to Glacier Point for rim views over Half Dome and the high country.

additionalInfo: Confirmation will be received at time of booking

faqs.question: How long is the Full-Day Small Group Yosemite & Glacier Point Tour Including Hotel Pickup?
Where does the tour depart from in Yosemite?
faqs.answer: Hotel pickup from select Fresno-area hotels between 6:00 AM and 6:30 AM.
